caseNameFull: Gerald Glen Boyden v. State of California
attorneys: Petitioner pro se., Stanley Mosk, Attorney General of California, William E. James, Assistant Attorney General, and David R. Caldwell, Deputy Attorney General, for respondent.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari is denied.
